origin: Phase 6 regression library first run (P6-SP-02, P6-SP-04, P6-SP-06), predicted before execution
expected_behavior: A present quotation whose lexical marker matches but whose content does not bear on the condition should be routed to review.
observed: identifiable_basis, chronology_integrity and reasoning_traceability reported supported from a report-view identifier, a revocation date and a renewal requirement.
limitation: Presence-only checking is the documented design of v0.3; the scenarios show where it reaches a favourable reading, not how often that happens in real records.

origin: Phase 6 regression library first run (P6-SP-07), predicted before execution
expected_behavior: A negated rationale ("does not need") should not stand as a stated reason; reasoning traceability should be routed to review.
observed: reasoning_traceability reported supported; the rationale marker matched the word "need" inside a negated sentence.
limitation: One constructed negation pattern; other negation forms were not tested.

origin: Phase 6 regression library first run (P6-CH-06); same class as Phase 4 RKB-041 (AR-010)
expected_behavior: An assessment dated after the decision should be surfaced as a sequence conflict and chronology routed to review.
observed: No conflict node; chronology_integrity supported. The ordered-pair check does not include assessment before decision.
limitation: Lexical role detection on one constructed record.

origin: Phase 6 regression library first run (P6-CH-07); same class as Phase 4 RKB-042 (AR-011)
expected_behavior: Two different expiry dates should be surfaced as a conflict and chronology routed to review.
observed: Only the first expiry date is read; chronology_integrity supported.
limitation: One constructed record with expiry wording in a revocation section.

origin: Phase 6 regression library first run (P6-CH-09) and stability transform P6-ST-12; first recorded in Phase 6
expected_behavior: A record stating no decision date anywhere should show a visible chronology gap and route chronology to review.
observed: chronology_integrity supported from request, assessment and expiry dates alone; the rule needs any two dated events, not a dated decision.
limitation: Constructed by removing the two decision dates from one record.
required_regression_suite: node tools/engine-reliability-replay.mjs (library); tests/engine-reliability/run.mjs group library; stability laboratory

origin: Phase 6 regression library first run (P6-CH-10); first recorded in Phase 6
expected_behavior: A stated grant duration that does not match the stated decision and expiry dates should be routed to review.
observed: No duration arithmetic is performed; chronology_integrity supported for a 30-day grant expiring about 90 days after the decision.
limitation: Whether duration arithmetic belongs in the Engine is a design decision; recorded as an open boundary, not a defect finding.

origin: Phase 6 regression library first run (P6-SU-07); same class as Phase 4 RKB-044 (AR-025)
expected_behavior: Log review stated as weekly and as not started should be surfaced as a control conflict.
observed: No conflict node; the control-noun list matches "log review" but not "review of access logs". Sufficiency stayed review_required, so the direction is not favourable.
limitation: One constructed paraphrase of a control state; other paraphrases were not tested.

origin: Phase 6 regression library first run (P6-XD-03) and stability transform P6-ST-17; same class as Phase 4 RKB-046 (AR-040, ST-14)
expected_behavior: Reworded employment language ("will not keep their job") should be refused at intake.
observed: Gate proceed; the record was assessed.
limitation: Lexical scope lists cannot anticipate every rewording; one rewording tested.
required_regression_suite: node tools/engine-reliability-replay.mjs (library); tests/engine-reliability/run.mjs group library; stability laboratory

origin: Phase 6 regression library first run (P6-RT-07): unexpected result, not predicted
expected_behavior: A candidate note attributing a motive should be withheld as a prohibited inference, with reasoning traceability routed to review.
observed: The compiler threw graph_self_validation_failed (GV-11): its own refusal reason "prohibited_inference:motive" contains a word its output check forbids, so no graph was produced.
note: INFERENCE, not tested: a note matching the discrimination pattern would produce "prohibited_inference:discrimination", which the fairness pattern also matches, and would likely fail the same way. The failure is closed (no output), but the human-review route and refusal record are lost with it.
limitation: Observed on one scenario; the frozen v0.3 compiler was not changed. A fix needs a separately authorized Engine change and its own regression run.
required_regression_suite: node tools/engine-reliability-replay.mjs (library); tests/engine-reliability/run.mjs group library; tests/engine-evidence-graph/run.mjs after any fix

origin: Phase 6 engineering observation while building the differential router
scenarios: proposed: mutation MU-07 differ trusts stored hash
expected_behavior: A behaviour record edited without updating its stored hash must not compare as identical.
observed: The first router draft returned no_behavioral_difference for such a record because it compared stored hashes. It now recomputes both hashes from content and fails closed on a mismatch.
limitation: Covers records in this framework only.

expected_behavior: An Engine change that newly refuses a record is more conservative and should reach human review.
observed: The router fails closed instead, because the earlier quotation refusals and presence limitations disappear when intake refuses the record.
limitation: Over-conservative by design: the assignment requires failing closed when a refusal disappears. Whether to treat a superseding intake refusal differently is an owner decision.

scenarios: proposed: v02 long-record gate in baseline
expected_behavior: Every baseline record should state its gate decision.
observed: The frozen v0.2 replay does not return the intake gate for its five long-record cases, so those baseline records carry gate null and their structure summary only.
limitation: Changing the v0.2 replay is outside this phase; the gap is recorded rather than filled.

origin: Phase 6 direct probe r.supersedes_must_be_earlier on the first test run
scenarios: proposed: probe r supersedes must be earlier
expected_behavior: Appending an entry that supersedes an entry not already in the register must be refused.
observed: The first register draft checked only the new entry on append, so a dangling supersedes reference was accepted until the next full check. Append now checks the whole resulting register.
limitation: Applies to this register module only.

origin: Post-stop, owner-authorized test-coverage repair after mutation MU-51 survived on the first mutation run (2026-10-17)
scenarios: proposed: probe l universal duplicate limitation detected
expected_behavior: A finding carrying two limitations must be reported by universal invariant U2.
observed: MU-51 disabled the exactly-one-limitation check and survived, because the only probe removed a limitation and a second check also fired on that case. One direct probe was added that gives a finding two limitations; no existing check was weakened, removed or reclassified and no sealed expectation changed. On the re-run MU-51 was killed by that probe alone and 64 of 64 mutations were killed.
limitation: Covers the duplicated-limitation case in the universal invariants only.
